method_notes: This meaning review compares candidate subject and learning scope with the supplied registered current-inventory records; it does not select mappings from labels alone.
Official sources and the Raft authors' paper were inspected remotely for semantic identity. For unavailable Berkeley content an additional official OpenStax definition was inspected.

Wikidata identity pages were inspected through the web tool where available. Returned pages may be cached: the tool reported crawl ages ranging from today to 1.3 years. No latest API revision or fully current remote snapshot is claimed.

Retained cards, aliases, and original source provenance must be preserved when the root applies reuse mappings. A narrower example does not independently create an identity or editorial facet. No source-supported or editorial relationship edge is proposed in this assignment.
